evals.name: report-and-plain-html-source
evals.prompt: Review ./report-review/report-excerpt.json and ./report-review/src. This is an offline synthetic report excerpt for a plain HTML site. Explain what needs work from both the report and code. Do not access the network or edit files. The deployed revision is unknown.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that source already includes the canonical link reported missing from deployed HTML. Leaves deployment mismatch unresolved. Finds the missing image alt text separately from engine findings. Provides file and line evidence without adding a framework or inventing a score.
assertions: Recognizes the synthetic excerpt and does not claim a real scan ran
Cites the existing canonical in src/index.html and does not blindly add a duplicate
Explains that deployed revision or rendered response evidence is needed to resolve the contradiction
Reports the missing alt text as a code finding with source evidence
No network calls or file mutations
No new framework, dependency, or invented score

evals.name: retrofit-existing-site
evals.prompt: My existing site is in ./existing-site (BrightPath Consulting, future domain https://brightpath.example). Improve its AI readiness using source evidence. No deployed site or report exists. Keep existing content. Do NOT run npm install, use the network, or build. Make only supported local fixes and tell me what remains unverified.
evals.expected_output: Local code inspection and focused fixes using the project's existing conventions. No fake Lighthouse baseline or blanket boilerplate. Preserves content and reports verification/deployment limits.
assertions: Existing content preserved, including 'Founded in 2021' and original service blurbs
No scan of the placeholder domain or fabricated report
Findings cite relevant source paths and code
No mandatory optional manifests or unrelated service-site validator
No installation or build
Local changes and missing deployed verification are distinguished

evals.name: audit-built-site
evals.prompt: Inspect ./built-site/dist for this sauna studio. Its future domain is https://nordwind.example. Tell me how ready it is for AI systems. Analysis only. No network or file changes. Give a score only if the available evidence supports a real Agent Lighthouse score.
evals.expected_output: Local output inspection with no Lighthouse score. Evidence-backed HTML findings and explicit live-evidence gaps. Optional llms.txt absence does not become a scored failure.
assertions: States local inspection and no Agent Lighthouse score
No network calls or file mutations
Identifies missing heading/alt/metadata with page evidence
Missing llms.txt is optional rather than a scored defect
Does not claim live headers, bot access, or booking execution were verified
Proposes relevant fixes without fixed category weights

evals.name: fix-scope-deployment-mismatch
evals.prompt: Use ./report-review/report-excerpt.json to fix confirmed issues in ./report-review/src. The report is a synthetic example for offline review. Keep this plain HTML project. No network, deployment, or form submission is allowed. Check other source defects too.
evals.expected_output: Avoids changing an already-correct canonical. Inspects and addresses supported source defects or requests missing content facts. Leaves live canonical finding unresolved. Reports local proof and pending deployment evidence.
assertions: Does not duplicate the canonical or mark its deployed finding fixed
Checks code beyond the one report finding
Does not invent an image description without evidence of its content
No framework scaffold or new dependency
No network, deployment, or form submission
Separates verified local work from unresolved deployment findings

evals.name: existing-stack-preserved
evals.prompt: Review the source files in ./report-review/src and propose AI-readiness fixes. Keep this plain HTML site. Do not edit files or access the network.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the HTML directly and proposes evidence-based fixes. Does not add a framework, a starter, or a dependency.
assertions: Preserves plain HTML as the project stack
No framework migration, starter, or dependency installation
Findings use source evidence and state no Lighthouse scan ran
